It could go on my record. On the other hand, this brief is really important to my boss&hellip;|Dooku and Eero Iridian|<ref name="LotJ" />}}
The '''Tolfranian brief''' was a legal document<ref name="LotJ" /> that shared its name with the [[Tolfrania system/Legends|Tolfrania system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In [[89 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the section of ''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]'' in which the Tolfranian brief is mentioned to [[89 BBY]].</ref> the [[Eero Iridian's species|alien]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senatorial]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Eero Iridian]] was working on composing the brief, a task that he found highly challenging yet also very important to his employer.<ref name="LotJ" />

That [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], wishing to obtain help for his team in a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi student]] training exercise, visited his friend Iridian at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on<ref name="LotJ" /> the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEA" /> When Dooku asked for Iridian's access [[code card]] for the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate's]] [[C level transport hallway]], the aide hesitated, leading the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to speculate that offering a favor in return would help motivate Iridian to comply with his request. Dooku then offered to help the alien with the work on the Tolfranian brief, and ultimately the offer made the conflicted and nervous Iridian agree to give the Jedi his access card.<ref name="LotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tolfranian brief was mentioned in [[Jude Watson]]'s [[2003]] young reader novel ''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]''.<ref name="LotJ" />
